# UK Train Dataset snapshot

Source: <https://github.com/jamie-lord/uk-train-dataset>

This directory contains an unmodified snapshot of `trains.csv` plus the
upstream MIT `LICENSE`. UK Activity Radar uses it only for exact rolling-stock
number matches. The upstream project warns that the data will never be wholly
complete or up to date, so it is displayed as reference context rather than a
live allocation source.

Service headcodes and Network Rail train UIDs are not looked up as vehicle
numbers. Update the snapshot only after reviewing the upstream licence and CSV
schema.
